name: dot-skill
description: Control Dot. devices from Codex with OpenAPI guidance and helper scripts.

interface.shortDescription: Control Dot. devices with OpenAPI helpers.
interface.longDescription: Dot Skill gives Codex focused guidance and Python helper scripts for Dot. OpenAPI workflows: listing devices, checking device status, switching content, and sending text, image, or Canvas API content with task alias support. API keys are read from the local DOT_API_KEY environment variable and are not stored in the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Send a message to my Dot device.
